score_kind: heuristic visual similarity (not a calibrated probability)
verdict: The render reproduces the parallelogram ABCD with correct vertex positions, edge connections, and label placement; the only visible difference is a heavier stroke weight.

issues.description: The rendered sides are noticeably heavier than the original outline (the render uses line width 2.2pt; the original strokes look roughly 1.5 to 2px at this scale).
issues.suggestion: If matching the original more closely is desired, reduce the \draw line width, for example to about 1.2pt, keeping line join=round.
